mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_credentials ( id, credential_group_id, previous_credential_id, credential_no, version_no, issuer_identifier, subject_identifier, credential_type, status, valid_from, valid_until, vc_payload, vc_hash, chain_key, vc_hash_version, issued_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason, failure_code, failure_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{credentialGroupId}, #{previousCredentialId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{credentialNo}, #{versionNo}, #{issuerIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subjectIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credentialType}, #{status}, #{validFrom, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{validUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{vcPayload, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vcHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chainKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vcHashVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{issuedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{revocationReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{failureCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{failureMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO tb_credentials ( id, credential_group_id, previous_credential_id, credential_no, version_no, issuer_identifier, subject_identifier, credential_type, status, valid_from, valid_until, vc_payload, vc_hash, chain_key, vc_hash_version, issued_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason, failure_code, failure_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{credentialGroupId}, #{previousCredentialId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{credentialNo}, #{versionNo}, #{issuerIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{subjectIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credentialType}, #{status}, #{validFrom, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{validUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{vcPayload, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vcHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chainKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{vcHashVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{issuedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{revocationReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{failureCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{failureMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (chain_key) WHERE chain_key IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_credentials WHERE id = #{credentialId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM tb_credentials WHERE credential_group_id = #{groupId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'ISSUING', 'ISSUED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING', 'ISSUING') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_credentials c JOIN tb_credential_groups g ON g.id = c.credential_group_id JOIN tb_completions completion ON completion.id = g.completion_id JOIN tb_enrollments enrollment ON enrollment.id = completion.enrollment_id WHERE enrollment.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT version_no FROM tb_credentials WHERE credential_group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_credentials SET issuer_identifier = #{issuerIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, subject_identifier = #{subjectIdentifier, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = #{status}, valid_from = #{validFrom, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, valid_until = #{validUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, vc_payload = #{vcPayload, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, vc_hash = #{vcHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, chain_key = #{chainKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, vc_hash_version = #{vcHashVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, issued_at = #{issuedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, revoked_at = #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, revocation_reason = #{revocationReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_code = #{failureCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_message = #{failureMessage, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
